name: Incident/RCA link MECHANISM check
label: mechanism-only: five pairs exist in the corpus, so this is NOT evidence of generalisation

questions.question: Why did mobile data drop out across a whole part of Mumbai that one time, and what was done so it would not happen again?
Why were some postpaid customers charged twice within one billing cycle, and how was that stopped from recurring?
What caused the home internet blackout in Pune after a cable was cut, and how was service brought back?
What was behind the period when nobody could sign in to the self-care app, and what was changed afterwards?
Customers got fake texts pretending to be from the operator - what happened and how was it handled?
